preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(S) <= 100000 for S in strings)
preconditions.description: Length of each string S is between 1 and 100,000.
Each string S contains only lowercase letters.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, int) for line in output)
postconditions.description: Each output line is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= count <= 2 * len(S) for count, S in zip(output, strings))
postconditions.description: For each string S, the count of valid insertion positions is between 0 and 2 times the length of S.
